record_bodies_after.courier-relay/cross-account-delivery-ide:
Courier Relay: cross-account delivery identity contract (established for trial-ewy, summary command, protocol "1").

delivery_id values are only guaranteed unique within a single account's receipts, not globally. When a request spans multiple accounts (e.g. the "summary" command), delivery identity for accept/duplicate purposes is the pair (account_id, delivery_id), not delivery_id alone. Two receipts with the same delivery_id but different account_id are distinct deliveries and never count as duplicates of each other.

Within one identity group, the accepted receipt is chosen the same way as the single-account "count" command: earliest occurred_at (compared as a UTC instant) wins, ties broken by the lexicographically (Unicode code-point) smallest record_id. All other receipts in the group are duplicates.

accepted_count = number of distinct (account_id, delivery_id) keys present; duplicate_count = total receipts - accepted_count. Empty batch -> 0/0.

Any future command that aggregates receipts across accounts (not just "summary") should use this same (account_id, delivery_id) identity unless a new approval explicitly overrides it. The single-account "count" command is unaffected and keeps deduping by delivery_id alone, since it operates on one account's receipts.

Basis: issue trial-ewy description ("Account attribution and delivery identity must follow that contract") plus no prior memory existed on this topic; this record establishes the contract going forward. Implemented in main.py via a shared dedupe(receipts, key_fn) helper.
